title: Check: Greenhouse Gases and Climate Change (2) (B)

questions.stem: Which of the following is evidence that Earth's climate is changing?

options.text: The ozone layer is getting thicker
Rising sea levels, melting ice caps, and increasing global temperatures
There are fewer volcanic eruptions than in the past
The amount of nitrogen in the atmosphere is increasing

questions.explanation: Key evidence for climate change includes rising global average temperatures (about 1.1 degrees C since 1850), melting ice caps and glaciers, rising sea levels (about 3.7 mm per year), ocean warming, and increasing frequency of extreme weather events. Over 97% of climate scientists agree humans are causing this change.
